sql:
SELECT r.text 
FROM rulings AS r 
JOIN cards AS c ON r.uuid = c.uuid 
JOIN legalities AS l ON c.uuid = l.uuid 
JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid 
WHERE c.setCode = 'CDS' AND fd.language = 'Italian'
